target_customer: Mid-size companies, notably hardware and manufacturing firms, needing purchasing and accounts payable workflow
problem: Purchase requests, approvals, POs and bill payment run through email and spreadsheets and do not sync to the ERP.

exit.reason: Support site indicates a sunset with customers moving to Precoro; exact terms not read

technical_complexity.rationale: Workflow plus ERP syncs with QuickBooks and NetSuite is standard SaaS engineering with integration effort.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and approval workflows create some switching costs, but many P2P vendors competed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Customers were migrated to Precoro on sunset, indicating a competitor absorbed the base.

market_need_then: Mid-size companies lacked affordable procurement tools; no spend or complaint data tied to 2021 was found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with unrelated products (Ctrl Hub design, ControlUp); no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: ControlHub was a procure-to-pay SaaS for mid-size companies from YC Winter 2021, reaching a team of 22 per the YC page. It is listed Inactive and its support site describes a sunset with customers transitioning to competitor Precoro. The reason for the wind down is not public; competition is suggested by the migration but is an inference.
notes: The sunset page was found by search snippet only; fetch failed because support.controlhub.com is not resolvable in this session, so dates and reasons are unread. Funding: a Spanish startup database lists a seed with a $125K program and about 114K euros total, another source lists seed in 2021-05; unverified, no round recorded. Cause of shutdown not public. Failure factor competition_won is an inference.
